gate.rule: United_States replication must pass AND >=2 other countries pass; a country passes when its predicted rest day is the lowest weekday with Bonferroni-adjusted null-test p < 0.05/m in >= 2 streams

replication_check.note: A fail here means investigate data, method and comparability with Earl et al. 2015; it is not by itself proof of a bug.

caveats: A robust rest-day dip is consistent with human scheduling of burning; it does not by itself establish ignition cause. Absence of a dip does not establish weather-driven fire.
Streams observe overlapping fires: agreement is corroboration, not independent replication.
Observation coverage (cloud, overpass gaps) by weekday is not measured.
gate.label: REAL FIRMS DATA

robustness.role: robustness checks reported next to the official decision; they never change it

descriptions.ci_upper_below_one: Rest-day 95% upper bound below 1.0 in at least two streams (official estimates).
descriptions.strict_reanalysis: Re-analysis using only years with both neighbouring annual archives, rest day lowest, 95% upper bound below 1 and fixed 21-test Bonferroni, in at least two streams.
descriptions.matched_static_controls: At least two per-country static-source control streams available, none showing a corrected rest-day dip.

strict_variant.rule: US and >=2 other countries each require >=2 streams with verified input years, rest day lowest, 95% upper bound <1 and fixed-family adjusted p<0.05; matching controls must be available and unflagged. Synthetic data never enable production.
